## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Sòng-period Esoteric *Aparimitāyuḥ-sūtra* by **Fǎtiān** ([法天](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E5%A4%A9)) — a Sòng-period parallel to [KR6j0108](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0108) (Fǎchéng's Táng-period *Aparimitāyuḥ-sūtra*). The two translations represent successive Chinese renderings of related Indian *Aparimitāyuḥ* materials.

**Abstract**

The text presents the *Aparimitāyuḥ-sūtra* in expanded form, integrating the basic Limitless-Life cult with the additional title-element *juédìng guāngmíng wáng* ("Decisively-Illuminating-King") — emphasizing the cosmic-illuminating aspect of the Buddha. The translation dates from Fǎtiān's career at the Sòng Yìjīngyuàn (980–1001).
